title: Row-Bot organisation policy (ai.row-bot)
description:
An organisation's policy for Row-Bot, schema version 1. Unknown keys are refused: a policy Row-Bot can't fully read locks Row-Bot down. Every setting a policy leaves out takes the value below; lockdown is what an unreadable, invalid or badly signed policy means.

| Setting | Not set in a policy | Lockdown |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `organisation.id` | none | none |
| `organisation.display_name` | none | none |
| `organisation.server_url` | none | none |
| `organisation.policy_version` | none | none |
| `organisation.contact` | none | none |
| `approvals.max_level` | auto | block |
| `models.allowed_providers` | any provider | [] |
| `models.allowed_models` | any model of an allowed provider | [] |
| `models.gateway_url` | none | none |
| `models.gateway_shape` | openai_chat | openai_chat |
| `models.personal_api_keys` | true | false |
| `models.subscription_sign_ins` | false | false |
| `models.local_models` | true | false |
| `tools.disabled` | [] | * |
| `tools.files_outside_workspace` | true | false |
| `channels.allowed` | discord, slack, sms, telegram | [] |
| `extensions.plugins` | any | none |
| `extensions.allowed_plugins` | [] | [] |
| `extensions.mcp_servers` | any | none |
| `extensions.allowed_mcp_servers` | [] | [] |
| `extensions.skills` | any | none |
| `extensions.allowed_skills` | [] | [] |
| `features.learning` | false | false |
| `features.proactive` | true | false |
| `features.remote_access` | false | false |
| `features.data_export` | true | false |
| `features.install_count` | false | false |
| `updates.channel` | the person chooses | stable |
| `updates.deferral_days` | 0 | 0 |
| `updates.pinned_version` | none | none |
| `updates.external` | false | true |
| `line.regulated` | false | true |
| `audit.sink` | local | local |
| `audit.redaction` | strict | strict |

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: Who the policy belongs to. Shown in Settings; nothing here changes behaviour on its own.

id.title: Organisation id
id.description: A short, stable id for the organisation. Not set in a policy: none. Lockdown: none.

display_name.title: Organisation name
display_name.description: The organisation's name as people see it. Not set in a policy: none. Lockdown: none.

server_url.title: Org server URL
server_url.description: The organisation's Row-Bot Org server. Not set in a policy: none. Lockdown: none.

policy_version.title: Policy version
policy_version.description: IT's own version label for this policy, shown in Settings. Not set in a policy: none. Lockdown: none.

contact.title: IT contact
contact.description: Who to contact about this policy, shown when Row-Bot is locked down. Not set in a policy: none. Lockdown: none.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: How far people may let Row-Bot act without asking.

max_level.title: Highest approval level
max_level.description: The highest approval level anyone may choose: block, approve (Ask), auto (reviewed) or full (Hands-off). Hands-off is allowed only when this is full. Not set in a policy: auto. Lockdown: block.

models.title: Models
models.description: Which models people may use, and how they reach them.

allowed_providers.title: Allowed providers
allowed_providers.description: Provider ids people may use (for example anthropic, openai, ollama, custom_openai_<endpoint>). Not set in a policy: any provider. Lockdown: [].

allowed_models.title: Allowed models
allowed_models.description: Provider-qualified model refs people may use (model:<provider>:<model id>). Not set in a policy: any model of an allowed provider. Lockdown: [].

gateway_url.title: Organisation gateway URL
gateway_url.description: An organisation model gateway Row-Bot offers as a provider. Not set in a policy: none. Lockdown: none.

gateway_shape.title: Organisation gateway API
gateway_shape.description: The API the gateway speaks. Needs gateway_url. Not set in a policy: openai_chat. Lockdown: openai_chat.

personal_api_keys.title: Allow personal API keys
personal_api_keys.description: Whether people may add their own API keys and custom endpoints. Not set in a policy: true. Lockdown: false.

subscription_sign_ins.title: Allow consumer subscription sign-ins
subscription_sign_ins.description: Whether people may sign in with a consumer subscription (Claude plan, ChatGPT/Codex, xAI Grok, OpenCode Go). Not set in a policy: false. Lockdown: false.

local_models.title: Allow local models
local_models.description: Whether people may run models on this computer (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio). Not set in a policy: true. Lockdown: false.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Which of Row-Bot's tools are switched off.

disabled.title: Disabled tools
disabled.description: Tool names switched off and locked (for example shell, computer_use, browser, developer); * switches off every tool. Not set in a policy: []. Lockdown: *.

files_outside_workspace.title: Allow files outside the workspace
files_outside_workspace.description: Whether tools may read or change files outside the workspace (each time still asked by the approval level). Not set in a policy: true. Lockdown: false.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Which messaging channels people may connect.

allowed.title: Allowed channels
allowed.description: Channel ids people may connect. The WhatsApp bridge (whatsapp) is unofficial, so it is allowed only when named here. Not set in a policy: discord, slack, sms, telegram. Lockdown: [].

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Which plugins, MCP servers and skills people may add.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: none, allow-list (only allowed_plugins) or any. Not set in a policy: any. Lockdown: none.

allowed_plugins.title: Allowed plugins
allowed_plugins.description: Plugin ids, when plugins is allow-list. Not set in a policy: []. Lockdown: [].

mcp_servers.title: MCP servers
mcp_servers.description: none, allow-list (only allowed_mcp_servers) or any. Not set in a policy: any. Lockdown: none.

allowed_mcp_servers.title: Allowed MCP servers
allowed_mcp_servers.description: MCP server names, when mcp_servers is allow-list. Not set in a policy: []. Lockdown: [].

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: none, allow-list (only allowed_skills) or any. Not set in a policy: any. Lockdown: none.

allowed_skills.title: Allowed skills
allowed_skills.description: Skill ids, when skills is allow-list. Not set in a policy: []. Lockdown: [].

features.title: Features
features.description: Features people may turn on. Off means off and locked; on leaves the person's own choice.

learning.title: Allow Learning
learning.description: Whether people may turn on Learning. Not set in a policy: false. Lockdown: false.

proactive.title: Allow Proactive Row-Bot
proactive.description: Whether people may turn on Proactive Row-Bot. Not set in a policy: true. Lockdown: false.

remote_access.title: Allow remote access
remote_access.description: Whether people may reach this Row-Bot from other devices. Not set in a policy: false. Lockdown: false.

data_export.title: Allow data export
data_export.description: Whether people may export their conversations and data. Not set in a policy: true. Lockdown: false.

install_count.title: Allow the install count
install_count.description: Whether the anonymous install count may be sent. Not set in a policy: false. Lockdown: false.

channel.title: Update channel
channel.description: stable or beta. Not set in a policy: the person chooses. Lockdown: stable.

deferral_days.title: Defer updates (days)
deferral_days.description: Days to wait after a release before offering it. Not set in a policy: 0. Lockdown: 0.

pinned_version.title: Pinned version
pinned_version.description: Stay on this version (for example 5.4.0). Not set in a policy: none. Lockdown: none.

external.title: Updates come from IT
external.description: Row-Bot never updates itself; IT deploys new versions. Not set in a policy: false. Lockdown: true.

line.title: Line
line.description: The Line between Personal and Work.

regulated.title: Regulated mode
regulated.description: Regulated mode for Work. It never changes Personal. Not set in a policy: false. Lockdown: true.

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: Where audit events go (placeholders; AUD-1 defines them).

sink.title: Audit sink
sink.description: local or org_server. Not set in a policy: local. Lockdown: local.

redaction.title: Audit redaction
redaction.description: strict or standard. Not set in a policy: strict. Lockdown: strict.
